title: Realplayz's Wild West Mod
description: A funny mod that revalves around being funny! It is aslo a role playing mod.
body:
🌵 Wild West Expansion Mod 🌵
Saddle up, partner! The Wild West Expansion mod brings the grit, danger, and charm of the frontier to your Minecraft world like never before. Whether you're taming the land or taking on outlaws, this mod adds a range of exciting new features that transform your gameplay into a high-noon showdown.

🔥 Key Features:
🛡️ New Western-Themed Armor
Craft rugged cowboy armor to protect yourself from the harsh desert sun and the dangers that lurk beyond. Designed to match the Wild West vibe, these armor sets give your character that true gunslinger look.

🔫 A Brand-New Gun
Face threats the frontier way—with firepower. The new gun allows you to take on mobs (and outlaws) with some serious punch. Ammo crafting and reload mechanics add an extra layer of realism and fun.

🍕 Pizza as a New Food Item
Who said cowboys can't enjoy some good food? Restore your hunger bar in style with delicious pizza—freshly crafted with ingredients from the old (and wild) world.

🤠 The Outlaw Mob
Beware the Outlaw—a tough new mob that roams the land, robbing villagers and attacking on sight. Fast, unpredictable, and well-armed, these foes bring real danger to your towns and deserts.

🏘️ New Villager Profession
Introducing a brand-new villager profession that fits right into the frontier lifestyle. Trade unique items and gear with these specialized villagers, and watch your town evolve into a Western settlement.

🌪️ The Wild Frontier Dimension
Discover the Wild Frontier, a brand-new dimension filled with red rock canyons, abandoned mines, mysterious structures, and unique resources. To enter, you'll need to craft a special portal frame and ignite it with a new key item. But be warned—this dimension is crawling with outlaws, strange wildlife, and secrets waiting to be unearthed.
